newsitem.title: UK: Misys says trading, order intake ahead.
newsitem.headline: Misys says trading, order intake ahead.

text.p: Applications software products company Misys Plc said on Wednesday that trading and order intake for the first three months of the year had been good and were comfortably ahead of last year.

"The banking division...continues to make excellent progress with its strong order book and increasing levels of activity auguring well for the future," Misys' chairman Kevin Lomax told the group's annual meeting.
Lomax said the insurance and information systems divisions were continuing to perform in line with expectations.
He said he was confident the group is strongly placed to deliver another year of good progress.
